docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Quasimodo, Esmeralda and the archdeacon Frollo in fifteenth-century Paris: Hugo's novel of the cathedral, the crowd and fate.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Victor Hugo (1802–1885), Notre-Dame de Paris (French), 1831, translated by Isabel F. Hapgood (1851–1928), 1888. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
